payload.analysis: Positive COVID-19 RT-PCR and CTPA with multifocal opacities and no embolism strongly support severe viral pneumonia as the cause of ARDS and AKI in this unvaccinated older patient. Inflammatory markers, blood cultures, and renal trend remain missing, so bacterial superinfection cannot be fully excluded, but no bacterial evidence exists. COVID-19 remains the leading diagnosis; key imaging and virologic data are covered.

payload.analysis: 结合当前最可疑的重症病毒性肺炎（COVID-19）诊断，患者SARS-CoV-2检测阳性直接证实病毒感染，CTPA显示多发磨玻璃样阴影符合病毒性肺炎表现，且无肺栓塞可排除血栓性呼吸衰竭。患者未接种疫苗、高龄、进展为ARDS需插管俯卧位并伴急性肾损伤，与重症COVID-19多器官受累高度一致。细菌性肺炎及非感染性ARDS缺乏特异性病原学或病因证据，可能性较低。所有关键信息已覆盖，支持重症病毒性肺炎诊断。

payload.report: The patient's presentation is best explained by severe viral pneumonia due to COVID-19. Positive SARS-CoV-2 RT-PCR directly confirms infection, and CTPA showing multifocal ground-glass opacities without pulmonary embolism is characteristic of viral pneumonia. Unvaccinated older age, progression to ARDS requiring intubation and proning, and acute kidney failure all support severe COVID-19. Bacterial pneumonia with sepsis and non-infectious ARDS are unlikely because the viral etiology is confirmed and no bacterial pathogen or non-infectious cause has been identified. The evidence strongly converges on severe COVID-19 pneumonia as the cause of the patient's respiratory failure.
